effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you have a blue Tamer in play, unsuspend 1 of your blue Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your Main Phase, it gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
